simple.meaning: מַשְׂאֵת (masʼêth) appears 16 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Judges, 2 Samuel, 2 Chronicles, Esther, and 6 more, beginning at Genesis 43:34. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as kingship, city, wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַשְׂאֵת (H4864) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows מַשְׂאֵת through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
simple.summary: מַשְׂאֵת (masʼêth) / H4864 is tracked through Genesis 43:34, Judges 20:38, Judges 20:40, 2 Samuel 11:8. The entry is generated from source alignment, occurrence evidence, and the surrounding Scripture context.

definitions.short: properly, (abstractly) a raising (as of the hands in prayer), or rising (of flame); figuratively, an utterance ; concretely, a beacon (as raised); a present (as taken), mess , or tribute ; figuratively, a reproach (as a burden)
definitions.usage: burden, collection, sign of fire, (great) flame, gift, lifting up, mess, oblation, reward.
definitions.full: H4864. maseth מַשְׂאֵת noun feminine uprising, utterance, burden, portion (on formation compare Ol § 109 a Sta § 272 b Kö ii. 1, 183 ; Phoenician (Pun) has משאת = payment, tax see Lzb 326 ); — absolute ׳מ Judg 20:40 +; construct מַשְׂאַת Gen 43:34 +; plural absolute מַשְׂאֹת 43:34 , + (probably) מַשְׂאוֺת Lam 2:14 (see below); construct מַשְׂאֹת Gen 43:34 ; — 1 that which rises, uprising, uplifting: a. ׳מ הֶעָשָׁן Judg 20:38 uprising of smoke , compare ( ׳הֶע omitted) 20:40 . b. in General = signal Jer 6:1 (= נֵס Gf.). c. uplifting of hands ( כַּמַּי ) in prayer Psa 141:2 (|| תְּפִלָּה ). 2 utterance, oracle (= III. מַשָּׂא ), Lam 2:14 (Bu Löhr). 3 burden Zeph 3:18 (of reproach, figurative). 4. a. portion (carried to some one), especially from table of king or superior, Gen 43:34 (3 t. in verse) (J; on custom see Di and references), 2Sam 11:8 ; so read perhaps also 19:43 (for נִשֵּׂאת ᵑ0 ) Gr HPS. b. perhaps also more Generally, present, largess from a superior Jer 40:5 ( + אֲרֻחָה food-allowance ), Est 2:18 ( הַמֶּלֶךְ כְּיַד ). c. exacted or enforced gift , from inferior, ׳מ בַּר Amos 5:11 (compare Phoenician above; see also מנחה ). d. sacred contribution, tax ׳מ משֶׁה ( ׳י ) עֶבֶד 2Chr 24:6 , 9 . e. offering to ׳י Ezek 20:40 .
